title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-002
doc_notes: This document is an archival record of FAA source files regarding the Japan Airlines Flight 1628 sighting, which contains detailed encounter reports and interview transcripts.

encounters.summary: Japan Airlines Flight 1628 reported unidentified traffic at their altitude for approximately 34 minutes while en route to Anchorage, Alaska.
encounters.quote: The unidentified traffic was later reported visible on JAL 1628's weather radar and intermittently by Anchorage Center
